subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Runtime object machinery reconstructed from validated function IR: an 8x8 spatial proximity grid (insert, box iteration, sprite tagging, per-cell child retag), an audio-mixer channel initializer, an AI performance/setup config initializer, session-phase countdown and a standings jump-thunk, pit-stop and generic cleanup/destructor helpers over singly linked lists, session scoring counters and clamped running averages, scene-list buffer management, a bounds-checked index container, guarded virtual dispatch through a global polymorphic object, particle-emitter initialization, a session validation guard, and a sorted-key range search.

summary: Thirty validated functions reconstructed into seventeen GUESS-level runtime-object classes plus three unknown-owner helpers. The largest coherent group is the spatial proximity grid: InsertIntoGridCells (0x004BE1D0, packet owner SpatialGridIndex DERIVED), GridCellIterate (0x004BE340) and SpriteGridRender (0x004BE4E0) all use the same transform fields (+0x924/+0x928 X origin/scale, +0x92C/+0x930 Y origin/scale) and the tag cursor +0x934; ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate (0x004BDA20) retags the children stored in a grid cell's two dynamic child arrays and dispatches them through SwitchBasedStateHandler. A family of eight adjacent session scoring helpers (0x004C2BE0..0x004C2DC0) is grouped into SessionScoringObject by a shared sample-count field (+0x28), counter field (+0x2C) and caller overlap (SeasonScoringInfoUpdater 0x004C2A80 / sub_4C29F0 0x004C29F0). Two linked-list destructors (0x004C2F20, 0x004C8210) share the same 12-byte owned-data node layout (data at +0, next at +4, ownership flag byte at +8). All packet owners except SpatialGridIndex are UNKNOWN; class identities and field meanings are GUESS proposals only. The x87/FPU compare-flag guards in several functions and nine float globals read by the fact table but absent from the raw source remain unresolved.

function_roles.role: Retag children of a grid cell's two dynamic child arrays: for the first array retag any element whose tag (dword +4) differs from a2 and whose type (dword +0x20) differs from a3, dispatching each through SwitchBasedStateHandler; for the second array retag any element whose tag differs from a2 (no type check); return this[4]. Both loops gate on the uninterpreted decompiled x87 flag expression !(v9|v10).

Initialize an audio-mixer channel object: run the field-initializer F_3FieldInitCall (0x004BD7D0) over 64 consecutive 9-dword sub-structures starting at this, run it once more at this + 576 dwords, zero the five trailing dwords at this[585]..this[589] (byte offsets 0x924..0x934), and return this.

Convert the float extent carried in a2 into four grid cell indices via CRTFtol against the grid transform (origin this+0x924 / scale this+0x928 for rows, origin this+0x92C / scale this+0x930 for columns), clamp each to 0..7, and append a2 to every cell of the covered rectangle with DynamicArrayAppendWithRealloc (0x004BD9B0); when any index clamped, also append to the fallback array at this + 576 and return the clamp/append status.

Iterate the spatial-grid cells overlapped by an axis-aligned box centred on a3 with radius a4: compute four clamped cell indices via CRTFtol ((pos -/+ radius - origin) * scale), call ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate (0x004BDA20) on every cell in the non-degenerate X/Y range passing the tag at this+0x934, additionally on the overflow list when any index clamped, then increment the counter at this+0x934 and return it. Invoked by ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch.

Render a sprite footprint into the 8x8 proximity grid: convert (a3[0], a3[2]) with radius a4 into clamped cell ranges via CRTFtol against grid origin (this+0x924 / this+0x92C) and scale (this+0x928 / this+0x930), call SphereProximityTag (0x004BDB10) for every cell of the covered rectangle tagging each with the tag cursor this+0x934, tag the extra cell at this+0x900 when any index clamped, then bump and return the tag cursor.

Initialize an AI performance/setup configuration struct to defaults: enable byte flags at +0x340 and +0x341, disable the flag at +0x342, write float parameters 1.0/1.0/600.0/10.0 at +0x344/+0x348/+0x34C/+0x350, zero the accumulators at +0x354 and +0x358, set the integer countdown 10 at +0x35C and mode identifier 5 at +0x360, and return 0.

Jump-thunk that forwards a thiscall of this to the RaceStandingsRankingsComputation implementation and returns its char result unchanged; the target implementation is outside this packet. Invoked by PitStopPhaseAdvance when session standings/rankings must be recomputed.

Advance a countdown timer driving a session-phase transition: when the timer-active flag byte at +45392 (0xB150) is non-zero, increment the counter at +45384 (0xB148), read the scene-order threshold via SceneOrderReader (0x004C1190), and when the counter reaches it set the session phase at +45380 (0xB144) to 3, reset the phase counter at +45388 (0xB14C) to 1 and clear the flag; return the threshold on the active path.

Pit-stop destructor-style method: run PitStopMemoryCleanup (0x004C0B10) on the object, then conditionally free the wrapper via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) when bit 0 of the flag argument a2 is set; always return the object pointer.

Conditional destruction of a two-pointer object: free the child pointer at this+0x8 when non-zero, free the child pointer at this+0x0 when non-zero, and when bit 0 of the flag a2 is set free the receiver this as well, all via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF); return this. Called by DoubleListCleanup.

Conditional dispatch wrapper: dereference the linked list behind this via LinkedListDereference (0x004C2850); when it yields a non-null node forward the node and argument a2 to the session config reader named in the raw source and return its result; on the null path return the indeterminate value of the uninitialized local v3. Invoked by DelegationChain.

Field accumulator: add the input a2 to the running total at this[9] (this+0x24) unconditionally and return the original input a2. Called by SeasonScoringInfoUpdater to accumulate a session scoring quantity.

Side-effecting counter increment: perform ++this[10], a read-modify-write of the dword at this+0x28, and return void. Called by sub_4C29F0. The packet's template prelabel (a side-effect-free getter of 0x28) contradicts the raw source and is not reflected here.

Accumulate the argument a2 into the caller's field at this+0x30 (this[12]) and return a2 unchanged. Called by SeasonScoringInfoUpdater as a field-accumulation step. A structural twin of ConditionalSetter0x30 per the prelabel cluster.
Void counter increment: pre-increment the caller's int32 field at this+0x38 (this[14]) by one, no guard, no callee, no return value. Invoked from SeasonScoringInfoUpdater.

Compute an incremental running average of input a2 using the sample count at this+0x28 as the weighting denominator and store the result at this+0x44; count 0 is a no-op, count 1 stores the input directly, otherwise the weighted average ((count-1)*old + input)/count; then clamp via an FPU compare-status branch writing 1065353216 (1.0f) or, above 22.0, 1102053376 (22.0f). Called by sub_4C29F0.

Compute an incremental moving average of input a2 using the sample count at this+0x28 and storing the result at this+0x48; base term is the old average at this+0x48 when count is 1, the raw input when count is 0, and (count-1)*old_average otherwise; zero-count stores the input directly, then the averaged value is clamped by an FPU compare-status branch to 1065353216 (1.0f) or, above 22.0, 1102053376 (22.0f). Called by SeasonScoringInfoUpdater.

Compute a running average of the per-call input scaled by 100.0, weighted by the sample count at this+0x28, and store the result at this+0x4C; count 0 stores the scaled input directly, count 1 keeps the previous average, count > 1 uses ((count-1)*average + scaled_input)/count; then post-process through a compare-status branch against 100.0 writing 1084227584 or, above 100.0, 1120403456.

Compute an incremental running average: increment the counter at this+0x2C (resetting to 1 when the old value is -1), accumulate old_count * previous_average(this+0x50) + input, divide by the updated counter and store at this+0x50; then post-process through a compare-status branch against 120.0 writing 1116471296 or, above 120.0, 1123024896.

Destroy a singly linked list and release the data each node owns: nodes are 12 bytes with a value pointer at +0, next at +4 and an ownership flag byte at +8; walk from the head at this+0, and for every flag-set node free its value wrapper (and the data object it points to when non-null), free each node via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then zero the four head dwords this+0/+4/+8/+0xC and return the last FreeWrapper result. Invoked by AIPathPerformanceFunction.

Reinitialize the 6-dword global array dword_8AC36C to the literal state { 0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0 } (index 1 set to -1 as the only non-zero entry), invoke SceneListCleanup(), and return a pointer to the reinitialized buffer.

Scene list and data cleanup: release primary scene-list resources via SceneListCleanup (0x004C4CF0), walk the singly linked list rooted at this+0x8 freeing each node's data payload when the node ownership flag byte at node+8 is set and freeing each node via FreeWrapper_7bcf, zero the four list pointers this+0x8..this+0x14, then free the primary pointer at this+0x0 when non-null and return the earlier result otherwise.

Bounds-checked index setter: store the candidate index a2 into the index field this[6] (offset 0x18) only when 0 <= a2 < this[5] (item count at offset 0x14); return a2 unchanged whether or not the write occurs.

Linked-list destructor with sub-free: walk the singly linked list rooted at *this (next pointer at node+4); for every node, if the flag byte at node+8 is set free the data object at node+0 (and its first member when non-null), then free the node via FreeWrapper_7bcf; the body appears as two successive walk/free passes each followed by zeroing the header this[0..3]; between the passes call ArithmeticComparison_8350 (0x004C8350) and return its result.

Guarded indirect call: when the global object pointer dword_8AC4C4 is non-null, read its vtable and call the __thiscall slot at vtable offset +16 (index 4) with dword_8AC4C4 as this, returning the call's result; on the null path fall through and return the uninitialized result register. Called from sub_46BF10, sub_46DC60 and sub_4A0250.

Guarded dispatch through a virtual method table: when the global object pointer dword_8AC4C4 is non-null, load its vtable, select the method slot at vtable byte offset +80 (index 20) and invoke it thiscall-style as (this=dword_8AC4C4, arg=a1), returning its int result; on the null path fall through and return whatever stale value is left in EAX.

Initialize a particle-emitter object: store the interface pointer off_5ACE2C at +0x0, clear state floats at +0x4, +0x8, +0xC and +0x10, set the emitter duration at +0x14 to the caller-supplied a2 (defaulting to 1.0 when a2 <= 0.0), compute a randomized end boundary v2 = flt_8AAE74[(byte)dword_8AAE70++] * 1.5 and store duration + v2 at +0x18, and return this.

Three-stage session validation guard: compute a short value from the global at 0x005EA510 via ShortComputation_c910 (0x0040C910), then return 1 only when the this+0x4 enable flag is non-zero, the computed value is non-zero, and sub_54C0E0 (0x0054C0E0) of the computed value is non-zero; otherwise return 0. Invoked from sub_4C8FC0.

Binary search over a sorted float key array rooted at this[104] with element count in the global dword_5C329C; return a pointer to the first element whose key lies within [a2 - a3, a2 + a3] and write the count of in-range elements to *a4, or null with *a4 = 0 when the count is zero. Callers are per-frame rendering and animation paths.

Free a dynamically-allocated child object held at this+0x50 when non-null: invoke the no-op stub EmptyStub_0170 (0x004B0170) and return FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) of the child; the null branch falls through to return an uninitialized result. Existing analysis places this on the SpecialFX_Post cleanup path.

classes.name: SpatialGridIndex
classes.responsibility: 8x8 proximity grid with a per-axis origin and scale transform, a monotonic tag cursor and an overflow cell: InsertIntoGridCells (0x004BE1D0) converts extents to clamped 0..7 cell indices and appends into each covered cell, GridCellIterate (0x004BE340) visits every cell overlapped by an axis-aligned box and runs the per-cell proximity tag pass, and SpriteGridRender (0x004BE4E0) tags every cell covered by a sprite footprint. All three share the transform fields at +0x924/+0x928 (X) and +0x92C/+0x930 (Y), the tag cursor at +0x934 and the overflow cell at +0x900. GridCellIterate also names the per-cell retag helper ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate (0x004BDA20) and is itself reached from ParticleEffectUpdateDispatch.

classes.name: GridCell
classes.responsibility: Spatial-grid cell object holding two dynamic child arrays (count at +0x4 / data at +0x8 and count at +0x10 / data at +0x14). ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate (0x004BDA20) walks both arrays and, depending on the uncompiled x87 guard, retags children whose stored tag dword (+4 of the child) differs from the incoming tag, dispatching them through SwitchBasedStateHandler (0x0040F380); the first array additionally requires the child type dword (+0x20) to differ. The cell is the per-cell receiver passed by SpatialGridIndex::GridCellIterate.

classes.name: AudioMixerChannel
classes.responsibility: Audio-mixer channel object initialized by running the field-initializer helper F_3FieldInitCall (0x004BD7D0) over 64 consecutive 9-dword sub-structures starting at this, once more at this + 576 dwords, and zeroing the five trailing dwords at byte offsets 0x924..0x934. The 9-dword sub-structure meaning and the owning class are unknown; the 'audio-mixer' label comes from the packet prose.

classes.name: AiPerformanceSetupConfig
classes.responsibility: AI performance/setup configuration struct initialized to defaults by PerformanceSetupStructInitializer (0x004BE700): two enabled byte flags (+0x340, +0x341), one disabled flag (+0x342), four float parameters 1.0/1.0/600.0/10.0 (+0x344/+0x348/+0x34C/+0x350), two zeroed accumulators (+0x354/+0x358), an integer countdown 10 (+0x35C) and a mode identifier 5 (+0x360). The purpose of each parameter depends on the owning struct's role in the AI performance/setup system, which is unidentified.

classes.name: SessionPhaseController
classes.responsibility: Session-phase transition machinery on the PitStopPhaseAdvance path: TimerCountdownWithStateTransition (0x004C1670) advances a countdown counter (+0xB148) while the timer-active flag (+0xB150) is set, reads the scene-order threshold via SceneOrderReader (0x004C1190) and, when the counter reaches it, sets the session phase (+0xB144) to 3, resets the phase counter (+0xB14C) to 1 and clears the flag. RaceStandingsRankingsComputationThunk (0x004C1660) is a pure forwarding thunk to an out-of-packet standings implementation on the same session path; its receiver may or may not be this same object.

classes.name: PitStopObject
classes.responsibility: Pit-stop object whose memory resources are released by a dedicated cleanup and whose wrapper allocation is conditionally freed on bit 0 of the destructor flag. PitStopCleanupConditionalFree (0x004C1E20) runs PitStopMemoryCleanup (0x004C0B10), then FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) when (a2 & 1) is set, and always returns the object pointer. No field evidence binds this receiver; the class name is a GUESS label from the packet prose.

classes.name: DoubleChildOwner
classes.responsibility: Object owning two child pointers at +0x0 and +0x8 that are conditionally released. ConditionalDestructor (0x004C1E40) frees the +0x8 child when non-zero, then the +0x0 child when non-zero, then the receiver itself when bit 0 of the flag is set, all via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF). Invoked by DoubleListCleanup (0x004C1700); the two-pointer 'double-list' interpretation is inferred from the caller name only.

classes.name: DelegationWrapper
classes.responsibility: Guarded delegation wrapper on the 0x004C29D0 chain: ConditionalCallWrapper (0x004C29B0) dereferences the receiver's linked list via LinkedListDereference (0x004C2850) and, when a non-null node results, forwards the node and argument a2 to the session config reader named only in the raw source; on the null path it returns the value of an uninitialized local. The reader's identity and address are not evidenced.

classes.name: SessionScoringObject
classes.responsibility: Session scoring/statistics object accumulating counters and maintaining clamped running averages. The field-accumulators and counters (0x004C2BE0 accumulates this+0x24, 0x004C2C00 accumulates this+0x30, 0x004C2BF0 increments this+0x28, 0x004C2C20 increments this+0x38) are called from SeasonScoringInfoUpdater (0x004C2A80) and sub_4C29F0 (0x004C29F0); the running-average filters (0x004C2C40 at this+0x44, 0x004C2CB0 at this+0x48, 0x004C2D30 scaled at this+0x4C, 0x004C2DC0 at this+0x50) all use the sample count at this+0x28 (or the counter at this+0x2C) as the weighting denominator and clamp their output via FPU compare-status branches. Grouping is by shared sample-count/counter fields and caller overlap; all packet owners are UNKNOWN, so the common-ownership claim is GUESS.

classes.name: OwnedDataLinkedList
classes.responsibility: Singly linked list whose 12-byte nodes own optional data payloads and whose destructors release node data and nodes then clear the four-slot header at +0x0..+0xC. LinkedListDestructorWithData (0x004C2F20) walks the head at this+0, freeing each flag-set node's value (and its data object) and each node via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF); ListDestructorWithSubFree (0x004C8210) does the same including a sub-free of the data object's first member and calls ArithmeticComparison_8350 (0x004C8350) between two decompiler-duplicated passes. The node layout (data at +0, next at +4, ownership flag byte at +8) is shared by both destructors.

classes.name: SceneList
classes.responsibility: Scene-list container: a primary scene-list pointer at +0x0 plus an owned-data linked list rooted at +0x8. SceneListAndDataCleanup (0x004C4930) releases the primary resources via SceneListCleanup (0x004C4CF0), drains the linked list freeing flag-set data payloads and nodes via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF), zeroes the four list pointers +0x8..+0x14, then frees the primary pointer when non-null. ResetSceneListBuffer (0x004C2FE0) targets the global 6-dword buffer dword_8AC36C (reset to { 0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0 }) and calls SceneListCleanup; the global-vs-this duality means the two functions may belong to different objects.

classes.name: IndexedContainer
classes.responsibility: Container holding an item count at +0x14 and a bounds-checked current index at +0x18. BoundsCheckedIndexSetter_6760 (0x004C6760) stores the candidate index into +0x18 only when 0 <= a2 < count and returns the candidate unchanged; out-of-range writes are silently dropped. The list the index selects is unidentified.

classes.name: GlobalObjectDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Guarded virtual dispatch through the global polymorphic object pointer dword_8AC4C4. InvokeVtableSlot4OnGlobalObject (0x004C8D80) invokes vtable slot +16 (index 4) and GuardedVirtualCall (0x004C8DC0) invokes vtable slot +80 (index 20), both thiscall with dword_8AC4C4 as this, and both return the uninitialized result register on the null path. The concrete type and the meaning of the two slots are not evidenced.

classes.name: ParticleEmitter
classes.responsibility: Particle-emitter object initialized by ParticleEmitterInit (0x004C8F10): interface pointer off_5ACE2C at +0x0, cleared state floats at +0x4/+0x8/+0xC/+0x10, duration at +0x14 (default 1.0 when the argument is non-positive), and a randomized end boundary at +0x18 computed as duration + flt_8AAE74[(byte)dword_8AAE70++] * 1.5. The randomized end boundary's downstream use and the interface role of off_5ACE2C are unknown.

classes.name: SessionValidationObject
classes.responsibility: Session-validation guard object with an enable/state flag at +0x4. ArithmeticComparison_9000 (0x004C9000) returns 1 only when the +0x4 flag is non-zero, the short value computed by ShortComputation_c910 (0x0040C910) from the global at 0x005EA510 is non-zero, and sub_54C0E0 (0x0054C0E0) of that value is non-zero; otherwise returns 0. The meaning of the short value and the check performed by sub_54C0E0 are not established.

classes.name: SortedFloatKeyRangeSearch
classes.responsibility: Binary search over a sorted float key array rooted at this[104] with element count in the global dword_5C329C. FindDriversInRange (0x004C9C70) locates the first key within [a2 - a3, a2 + a3], writes the number of in-range elements to *a4 and returns the first in-range key pointer, or null with *a4 = 0. Per-frame rendering/animation callers suggest a spatial-range query role, but the owning object and the key meaning are unknown.

classes.name: SingleChildOwner
classes.responsibility: Object holding a dynamically allocated child at +0x50. FreeChild (0x004CA410) invokes the no-op stub EmptyStub_0170 (0x004B0170) and returns FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) of the child when it is non-null; the null branch returns an uninitialized result. Existing analysis names the owner SpecialFXFreeChild on the SpecialFX_Post cleanup path, but that attribution is not adopted here because the packet owner is UNKNOWN.

state_machines.name: SessionPhaseCountdown
transitions: Inactive -> Counting: timer-active flag at +0xB150 becomes non-zero
Counting -> PhaseTransitionToThree: countdown counter at +0xB148 reaches the SceneOrderReader threshold
PhaseTransitionToThree -> Inactive: session phase at +0xB144 set to 3, phase counter at +0xB14C reset to 1, timer-active flag cleared to 0

interfaces.name: PolymorphicDispatchTarget
interfaces.purpose: Object behind the global pointer dword_8AC4C4 exposing a vtable whose slot at byte offset +16 (index 4) and slot at byte offset +80 (index 20) are invoked thiscall by the guarded dispatchers (0x004C8D80 and 0x004C8DC0). The concrete type and the semantics of both slots are resolved only at runtime and are not evidenced by this packet.

compatibility_contracts.name: SpatialGridTransformContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement must preserve the proximity-grid transform: fields +0x924/+0x928 (X origin/scale) and +0x92C/+0x930 (Y origin/scale) convert world coordinates to cell indices via CRTFtol((pos - origin) * scale) clamped to 0..7, and out-of-range positions are routed to the overflow cell rather than dropped.

compatibility_contracts.name: GridCellProximityTaggingContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement must preserve that grid cells hold two dynamic child arrays and that children whose stored tag dword (+4) differs from the incoming tag and whose type dword (+0x20) differs from the incoming type are retagged and dispatched through SwitchBasedStateHandler; cell iteration and sprite tagging advance the grid tag cursor at +0x934.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionPhaseCountdownContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement must reproduce the countdown-driven phase transition: while the timer-active flag at +0xB150 is set, the counter at +0xB148 increments each call and, once it reaches the SceneOrderReader threshold, the session phase at +0xB144 is set to 3, the phase counter at +0xB14C reset to 1 and the timer-active flag cleared to 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: OwnedDataReleaseContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement must route owned-data frees through a single release routine (FreeWrapper_7bcf at 0x00587BCF): list nodes carry an ownership flag byte at +8 that decides whether the data pointer at +0 is released before the node itself, conditional frees key on bit 0 of the destructor flag, and list destructors clear the four header dwords at +0x0..+0xC after draining.

unresolved: All `this` object owners are UNKNOWN in the packet except SpatialGridIndex (DERIVED for 0x004BE1D0); every other class identity in this proposal is a GUESS-level label for an otherwise unnamed receiver.
ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate (0x004BDA20): the guards !(v9|v10) and !(v15|v16) read uninitialized locals from the decompiled x87/FPU comparison; the real flag semantics are not evidenced.
GridCell child layout (tag dword at +4, type dword at +0x20) is on the pointed-to child objects, not on the packet's this fields; only the dword indices are visible.
The type-field check v7[8] != a3 appears only in the first child-array loop of 0x004BDA20; the second loop omits it, which may or may not be intentional.

AudioMixerChannelInit (0x004BDB90): the meaning of the 64 repetitions of the 9-dword sub-structure and of the helper F_3FieldInitCall (0x004BD7D0) is unknown; no caller is recorded in the packet so the construction site is unknown.

The offsets 0x924..0x934 coincide on the SpatialGridIndex class (grid transform + tag cursor) and the AudioMixerChannel class (trailing zeroed dwords). Equal offsets on unrelated this pointers do not prove common ownership; the two classes keep them as separate fields despite the identical receiver offsets.

InsertIntoGridCells (0x004BE1D0): the meaning of a2[3]/a2[5]/a2[6] (range extents) is inferred from the arithmetic; the element layout of a2 is unproven; the fallback array at this + 576 (byte offset 0x900) is referenced in raw source but has no permitted field evidence ref; the cell geometry (9 floats per cell, 72 floats per row) is inferred from the loop strides only; the relationship to sub_4BDE20 (004bde20) is DERIVED, not confirmed.

GridCellIterate (0x004BE340): the overflow list base at this+0x900 has no packet field evidence ref; the meaning of the counter/tag at +0x934 (iteration counter vs per-object tag id passed to ProximityCheckWithTagUpdate) is not fully confirmed; the a3 float-array layout (indices 0 and 2 as X/Y centres) and the grid storage layout are inferred.

SpriteGridRender (0x004BE4E0): the 36-byte cell and 72-dword row-stride geometry is inferred from the loop arithmetic; only a3[0] and a3[2] are read so the position-vector layout is unknown; the purpose of the extra-cell tag at this+0x900 is not named by evidence.

PerformanceSetupStructInitializer (0x004BE700): the purpose of the float parameters (1.0, 1.0, 600.0, 10.0) and of the integer fields 10 and 5 depends on the unidentified owning struct; the global dword_5ACDAC (0x005ACDAC) is listed as read by the fact table but does not appear in the raw decompiled source.

RaceStandingsRankingsComputationThunk (0x004C1660): the jump-thunk target is not listed in the packet callees, so its address and implementation are outside this packet; the standings/rankings semantics and the abi LEGACY FAIL are resolved only at the target.

TimerCountdownWithStateTransition (0x004C1670): the meaning of session-phase value 3 at +0xB144 is unknown and the wider transition is owned by the caller PitStopPhaseAdvance; the return value on the flag-zero path is unspecified; the meaning of SceneOrderReader is unknown.
PitStopCleanupConditionalFree (0x004C1E20): no caller is recorded in the packet; FreeWrapper_7bcf free-vs-delete semantics are not defined here.
ConditionalDestructor (0x004C1E40): why the object keeps two child pointers at +0x0 and +0x8 (double-list nodes per the caller name DoubleListCleanup) is inferred, not grounded.

ConditionalCallWrapper (0x004C29B0): v3 is declared but never assigned, so the null-path return value is indeterminate; SessionConfigReader appears only in the raw source text with no callee evidence ref or address; the meaning of a2 is not documented.

IncrementFieldAt28 (0x004C2BF0): the packet prelabel (a side-effect-free getter of 0x28) contradicts the raw source, which performs a side-effecting increment and returns void; the packet field entry marks this:0x28 read-only (R) while the raw source performs a read-modify-write.

AccumulateField30AndReturnInput (0x004C2C00): the semantics of the accumulated field at +0x30 are not evidenced; the structural-twin relationship to ConditionalSetter0x30 (cluster_rep 004980c0) is a prelabel cluster claim only.

RunningAverageFilter (0x004C2C40): globals flt_59E43C and flt_59E85C are read per the deterministic facts but do not appear as symbols in the raw source; the v6|v7 compare-flag test is a decompiler artifact of an FPU compare.
